name: Bailing
description: Open voice assistant, oriented to Chinese speech, that chains voice activity detection, recognition, an LLM and speech synthesis.
whatItDoes: Holds spoken conversations on a local machine, remembers context across turns and can call tools to complete tasks. It is aimed at hobbyists who want a low-latency talking assistant without a dedicated GPU.
howItWorks: Microphone audio passes through Silero voice activity detection and FunASR recognition, then to a language model, with replies synthesised by engines such as edge-tts, Kokoro or ChatTTS. A memory module and function calling extend the dialogue, and an optional server component adds a web front end.

requirements.name: LLM API key
requirements.description: Key for the configured model, DeepSeek in the default configuration
